newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan minister flys to Gulf to lure investors.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan minister flys to Gulf to lure investors.

text.p: Morocco's Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj flew to the Gulf on Thursday to meet Saudi and Kuwaiti businessmen in a move aimed at luring Arab investors, a Moroccan official said.
Kabbaj, who is accompanied by a delegation of government officials, is also expected to confer with officials of the Islamic Development Bank, an official at the finance ministry said.
"The delegation will focus its talks during the four-day visit on business opportunities in Morocco and ways to attract Arab investments in future," the official said.
Foreign investments in Morocco fell to 3.3 billion dirhams ($354 million) in the 11 months to November 1996 from 3.4 billion dirhams in the same period IN 1995.
